message: The latest deploy changed the payment timeout from 3000 to 3.

evidence.summary: Commit a1b2c3d changed only the payment timeout value.
evidence.detail:
commit a1b2c3d  tune payment timeout
--- a/app/config.py
+++ b/app/config.py
@@ -4,3 +4,3 @@
 # Payment provider deadline in milliseconds.
-PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS = 3000
+PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS = 3
 PAYMENT_RETRIES = 1

message: The deploy supplied seconds to a millisecond setting: the payment deadline is now 1,000 times shorter.

root_cause.explanation: The latest deploy changed PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS from 3000 to 3. The payment client interprets this as milliseconds, so routine provider calls time out.

evidence.summary: The payment client converts PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS to seconds.
evidence.detail:
12  async def authorize(amount):

14          settings.PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000
15      ):
16          return await provider.charge(amount)

message: Recorded sandbox result: checkout fails against a provider with a normal 120 ms response.

evidence.summary: The reproducing test fails on the faulty configuration.
evidence.detail:
[RECORDED REHEARSAL]
tests/test_repro_payment_timeout.py::test_checkout_accepts_normal_provider_latency FAILED
E   PaymentUnavailable: Provider timed out
Provider latency: 120 ms; configured deadline: 3 ms

message: Three candidate patches are ready for isolated verification.

candidates.title: Restore payment timeout
candidates.rationale: Restore the previous 3,000 ms timeout. One configuration line changes; payment validation stays intact.
candidates.patch:
--- a/app/config.py
+++ b/app/config.py
@@ -4,3 +4,3 @@
 # Payment provider deadline in milliseconds.
-PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS = 3
+PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS = 3000
 PAYMENT_RETRIES = 1

candidates.title: Raise timeout to 30 ms
candidates.rationale: Try a smaller deadline increase to test whether the provider can meet a tighter latency budget.
candidates.patch:
--- a/app/config.py
+++ b/app/config.py
@@ -4,3 +4,3 @@
 # Payment provider deadline in milliseconds.
-PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS = 3
+PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30
 PAYMENT_RETRIES = 1

candidates.title: Bypass provider timeout
candidates.rationale: Catch provider timeouts and accept checkout. This may hide errors; the payment safety tests must decide.
candidates.patch:
--- a/app/payments.py
+++ b/app/payments.py
@@ -18,3 +18,3 @@
     except TimeoutError:
-        raise PaymentUnavailable("Provider timed out")
+        return PaymentResult(status="approved")
